name: Emily
source:
Raised by [url=https://vndb.org/c131856]Natalie[/url], Emily generally had a regular childhood alongside her two sisters [url=https://vndb.org/c131859]Jessie[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c131857]Melanie[/url]. Around the time she turned 11, Natalie adopted [url=https://vndb.org/c131855]Frank[/url], a boy whose families kept passing away in tragic situations. Most kids her age might have been nervous to have a boy like that in their home, but Emily was determined, and maybe a little naive, to befriend him. She struggled to connect with Frank at first, but through her determination, she finally managed to have him open up and they quickly became inseparable.

Her Hetero Dichromia has fascinated her and those around her for a long time. She has a green eye and a striking blue eye that almost seems to emit light at times. Even doctors are stunned when they examine her, due to the unusually reflective nature of her blue iris.

Academically, Emily has the best performance in the household. She is especially talented when it comes to science and mathematics, but she prefers her english classes and loves to read "long and boring books" as Jessie would often comment. As a result of her Hetero Dichromia and studious nature, Emily was often bullied as a child and the only people who stood up for her in school during this time were Melanie, and later, Frank.
